buzzwords.reason: Vague subjective claim that every applicant makes; replace with concrete deliverables and achievements.
buzzwords.replacement: Consistently delivered projects on schedule or exceeded quality metrics.

buzzwords.reason: Overused cliché; show collaboration by highlighting cross-functional partnerships or peer mentorship.
buzzwords.replacement: Collaborated with cross-functional teams of designers, engineers, and product managers.

buzzwords.reason: Generic filler phrase; demonstrate this by stating specific metrics (e.g. latency reduced by 30%, revenue increased by $50k).
buzzwords.replacement: Driven by measurable outcomes, evidenced by quantifiable project metrics.

buzzwords.reason: Casual slang unsuited for a professional resume.
buzzwords.replacement: Proactively initiated and executed projects ahead of timeline.

buzzwords.reason: Empty corporate jargon that adds no informative value.
buzzwords.replacement: Cross-team alignment or unified architectural design.

buzzwords.reason: Subjective cliché; demonstrate autonomy through projects spearheaded or self-directed learning.
buzzwords.replacement: Independently architected and delivered proof-of-concept solutions.

buzzwords.reason: Trite idiom; explain the novel technical or business solution you developed.
buzzwords.replacement: Devised innovative algorithmic solutions to complex data processing challenges.

buzzwords.reason: Telling rather than showing; demonstrate attention to detail through rigorous unit testing, zero defect rates, or clean code.
buzzwords.replacement: Maintained 99.8% test coverage and zero regression bugs in production.

buzzwords.reason: Common filler phrase; prove it by showing how quickly you mastered and shipped with a new tech stack.
buzzwords.replacement: Rapidly mastered and shipped production services with newly adopted frameworks within 3 weeks.

buzzwords.reason: Unprofessional and informal title; state your actual expertise or role level.
buzzwords.replacement: Subject matter expert or senior specialist in backend systems.

buzzwords.reason: Unprofessional buzzword that confuses ATS scanners.
Vague buzzword disliked by technical hiring managers.

buzzwords.replacement: Aligned engineering roadmaps with business KPIs.

buzzwords.reason: Cliche statement; let your accomplishments and quantitative outcomes speak for themselves.
buzzwords.replacement: Demonstrated history of delivering high-impact systems.
